question: How does revising training and evaluation labels change the severe-minus-broad AUROC gap on matched cohorts?
conclusion: For the primary keep scenario, all six full-revision gap changes are positive in point estimate and their conditional 95% intervals include zero.
archetype: quantitative grid with a paired-effect panel
reuse: style-only inheritance from the existing manuscript figures; statistical layout built for this question
panel_a: All 24 gap point estimates: four training/evaluation cells, three official splits and two severe endpoints. Marginal intervals are available in source data; the inferential focus is the paired change in panel b.
panel_b: All six P/P-minus-O/O gap changes with the reported paired scaffold-cluster percentile intervals; zero retained on the axis.
selection: Scenario=primary, Unresolved=keep, Representation=ECFP; all splits, both severe endpoints, all four cells and full-change rows. No result-dependent filtering.

field_map.Gap: AUROC(severe)-AUROC(100), or the difference of those gaps for change rows

cohort: 828 training and 207 test compounds in each official split; identities matched within each four-cell comparison
uncertainty_scope: Conditional on fitted models, membership and implemented label mapping; exploratory, not multiplicity adjusted across scenarios.
alignment: Two plot rectangles with common top/bottom edges and row centers; 1.5 pt tolerance; final rendered geometry recorded.
data_integrity: Verify all 24 gaps from saved compound scores and all six change intervals from regenerated resampling before export.
